title: Porchetta Roast with Italian Fennel Sausage Stuffing

ingredientSections.heading: Porchetta
items: 1 boneless, rind-on pork belly with or without loin

ingredientSections.heading: Stuffing
items: 4 Cups brioche bread, medium dice or ripped

methodSections.heading: Prepare the Pork Belly
steps: Trim and square off the pork belly, this will make it easier to roll and cook evenly. With the belly skin side up, use a sharp knife to score the meat roughly 1cm deep in a diamond shape pattern.
Using a pesto and mortar or a coffee grinder, grind the black peppercorns, salt and rosemary as finely as possible to form a dry rub and then add the chili flakes and minced garlic.
Season the scored side of the belly with the rub evenly.

methodSections.heading: Stuffing
steps: Remove the casings from the sausages if you bought them cased and slice the onions.
Heat the olive oil and butter in a large pan over medium-high heat. Add the sausage, onion, fennel and cook the sausage meat fully.
Add the white wine and reduce by half. Add chicken stock, bring to a simmer and then remove from heat. Add in bread cubes, sage, salt and pepper. Mix well then allow to cool.

methodSections.heading: Roll the Pork Belly
steps: Flip the belly over to skin side down. Arrange the stuffing in a mounded strip down the middle of the pork belly. Roll the belly into a tight cylinder ending up with the seam on the underside.
Slide 2-foot-long pieces of butcher's twine under the cylinder 1-2 inches apart. Tie the twine around the roast very tightly from the ends and then moving toward the centre in an alternating manner.
Season the roast, wrap in plastic, and allow to rest in the fridge for a minimum of 12 hours.

methodSections.heading: Roast the Porchetta
steps: Remove the roast from the fridge a few hours before cooking.
If using a convection oven turn the fan off. Preheat to 150°C (300°F).
Place the roast on a wire rack and the rack on a roasting pan.
Roast for approximately 3 hours, rotating every 45 minutes. Cook the roast until its internal temperature is around 60°C (135°F), it will continue cook while resting. Rest for 45 minutes to an hour.
Peel the crackling off and chop roughly. Transfer the rested Porchetta to a serving platter. Don't discard the oven pan drippings.

methodSections.heading: Caramelized Onion Gravy
steps: Place roasting pan over a medium heat, add the red wine and bring to a simmer while scraping the sticky caramelized bits from pan.
Add the chicken stock and bring to simmer. Strain sauce from pan into a bowl. Skim the fat from surface of the liquid and discard.
Add a splash of oil and knob of butter to a saucepan over a medium heat. Add onions and sauté until they are starting to brown then add minced garlic and cook for 30 seconds.

Add the flour and cook over a low heat for 5 minutes. Slowly add the liquid from the roasting pan while constantly stirring using a wooden spoon. Adjust the thickness of the gravy using hot chicken stock.

methodSections.heading: Serve
steps: Carve the Porchetta roast into 2-3cm slices. Serve with mashed potatoes, onion gravy, crackling and vegetables.
